newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Distribution of free land by Jeddah municipality to Saudis to begin soon, official says.
- Saudi Arabia is the largest Arab importer of German goods, study says.
- Family of Australian nurse says officials in Saudi should punish the two British nurses charged with murdering her.
